cues: This is the Seebeck effect, discovered by Thomas Seebeck in eighteen twenty one.
Two wires of different metals form a closed circuit.
Keep the two junctions at different temperatures, and an e m f appears, and a current flows.
The e m f is the thermo e m f, and the pair of metals is a thermocouple.
